scope.summary: WP-12 0341/0346/0348/0349 migrations and cross-table guards receive collision-safe replacement/removal and optional one-way data import, with no presumed legacy compatibility window.
acceptance_criteria: WP-12 migrations 0341, 0346, 0348, and 0349 plus their cross-table guards receive collision-safe removal/replacement and any approved one-way data import, with no legacy compatibility window.
[positive] Rehearse fresh, legacy-populated, partially migrated, collision, and already-current databases and reconcile schema, records, guards, and import dispositions.
[negative] Legacy migrations cannot re-run, recreate retired tables/routes, shadow current IDs, or force dual-read/dual-write compatibility into the current schema.
[failure_recovery] Interrupted migration resumes or enters rollback-safe mode from durable phase receipts, preserving source data and reporting exact unresolved collisions.
[concurrency] Concurrent application instances fence migration ownership and cannot interleave schema phases, recreate retired tables, or double-import a record.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Bind at implementation: headless/backend MT records typed NOT_APPLICABLE reason; operator-visible behavior requires Argus.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
Legacy Stage code (WP-12) must not silently constrain this MT (STAGE-DEC-017).
Do not duplicate ArtifactStore, WP-1 ToolGate/process/promotion, or Loom authority.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

planning_metadata.implementation_note: Planning-stage MT. Exact owned_files, code anchors, and proof_commands are bound at the L00 integration baseline. Deep spec detail lives in corpus_refs; acceptance_criteria carry the provable closure unit and the positive/negative/failure_recovery/concurrency case groups.
